definitions.explanation: An abbreviation of 原子力発電所. Refers to facilities that generate electricity using nuclear fission.

examples.japanese: {原発|げんぱつ}を{再稼働|さいかどう}する。
{原発|げんぱつ}{事故|じこ}のニュースが{流|なが}れた。
examples.english: News of a nuclear plant accident was broadcast.

examples.japanese: {原発|げんぱつ}に{賛成|さんせい}か{反対|はんたい}かで{意見|いけん}が{分|わ}かれている。
examples.english: Opinions are divided on whether to support or oppose nuclear power plants.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {原発|げんぱつ}{事故|じこ} (nuclear power plant accident)
- {原発|げんぱつ}{再稼働|さいかどう} (restart of a nuclear plant)
- {原発|げんぱつ}{反対|はんたい} (opposition to nuclear power)
- {原発|げんぱつ}ゼロ (zero nuclear power)

FORMS:
Abbreviation of {原子力発電所|げんしりょくはつでんしょ} (nuclear power generation station). After the 2011 {福島|ふくしま}{第一|だいいち}{原発|げんぱつ}{事故|じこ}, this word became central to public discourse in Japan. The debate over {脱原発|だつげんぱつ} (phasing out nuclear power) versus {原発|げんぱつ}{再稼働|さいかどう} (restarting plants) remains a major political topic.
